snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.2: Heart of Chornobyl — Just the Beginning Trailer
snippet.description:
The Zone is no stranger to death, and you will never get anywhere if you are afraid of failures. Every day, stalkers chase their dreams. For some it’s money, for some it’s fame, for some it’s survival. 

Only the boldest dare to uncover the Zone’s secrets, risking everything for a chance at the truth. Ward, SIRCAA, Spark — they’re all here, driven by the same question:

Is the truth worth the risk?

S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is available now on PC and Xbox Series X/S. Customize, or completely turn off the HUD, tweak the FOV, and lose yourself in the Zone.  Are you ready for the expedition of a lifetime?

Buy now on PC: https://bit.ly/3Wg6AGC
Buy now on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/stalker-2-heart-of-chornobyl-ultimate-edition-pre-order/9NJ1V5MDNWP2/0017
